verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Error Resolution provides in-product, AI-powered suggestions on the root cause of errors and how to fix them. It auto-prompts an LLM (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI) with stack trace, environment and code context, and offers a collaborative chat whose results can be posted to error comments. Missing for 10: AI insights beyond crash reporting (no evidence for APM/RUM data), no independent or hands-on corroboration, and setup appears to require bringing your own OpenAI API key.
